versions.changelog:
- Updated the authorization check to use a direct API HTTP status method for improved reliability.
- Changed the user onboarding/setup message link to https://gformsfree.com/app.
- Updated rules to require outputting the unauthorized setup message verbatim, with no summaries or extra text.
- Version bump to 1.2.

- Switched environment/auth check from Python script to Bash command for improved compatibility.
- Updated all usage examples to use Bash with inline Python (python3 -c or heredoc) instead of direct Python code blocks.
- No core logic or functionality changes.
- Improved clarity and consistency in command instructions and rules.

Initial release: Integrates Google Forms with managed OAuth and API key support.

- Create Google Forms, add questions, and share respondent/edit links.
- Export form responses to Excel with time-limited download URLs.
- Summarize response data and show trends for any form.
- List all user forms and provide related URLs.
- Enforces secure setup: always checks for API key and guides setup if missing.
- Handles errors with clear, actionable user messages.
